title: Marcus Rashford out of Barcelona’s Copa del Rey semi-final with knee injury – Hansi Flick
content:
Marcus Rashford is unavailable for Barcelona’s Copa del Rey semi-final first leg against Atletico Madrid with a left knee injury, Hansi Flick has said.

Rashford, 28, played 67 minutes of their 3-0 league win against Mallorca on Saturday before being replaced by Ferran Torres.

The England international has made 34 appearances this term after joining on a season-long loan deal from Manchester United.

Barcelona issued a statement on Wednesday confirming he had picked up a knock during the victory and was in pain.

“We have problems in the team,” Flick said in his pre-match press conference.

“Marcus won’t be able to play, he took a knock, he’s in pain and we have to look after him. I believe in my team and we rise to the occasion in difficult situations.”

Rashford is the second forward to sustain an injury before the Atletico tie as Flick confirmed Raphinha was taking a “step back” after a muscle issue. The 29-year-old Brazilian has not played since January’s 3-1 win against Elche.

“Step by step, we have to take care of him,” Flick said. “He always gives his all, with high intensity, and when he feels any discomfort, we have to take care of him and take a step back.

“I’m not happy because we need him, just like the rest of the injured players. He’s feeling something in his muscle and that’s normal. You have to take care of your body, that’s the most important thing. We have to support him and keep an eye on him.”

Rashford has registered 10 goals and provided 13 assists since joining the Catalan side, including one of each in the Copa del Rey. The Athletic reported in January that Barcelona want to keep the forward beyond his loan deal, which has a €30million (£26m; $34.9m at current rates) buy option.

Raphinha has registered 13 goals and five assists this season, his fourth at the club since transferring from Leeds United in 2022.

The first leg of the semi-final against Atletico will take place on Thursday, before Barcelona host the return fixture on March 3.
